title: debug.mic
description: TEST FIRMWARE ONLY (v0.3.1). Sets the microphone gain for the next recordings; a recording already running keeps its own. pga: ES8311 REG14 PGA in 3 dB steps (0-10 = 0..+30 dB); vol: ES8311 REG17 ADC volume in 0.5 dB steps (191 = 0 dB); mag: M5Unified magnification with over_sampling 1 (2 = unity). Reply: ack or error.
